detail.longDescription: A sandbox that blocks file writes but leaves loopback open is one command away from no sandbox. DeepSeek Harness trusted its unauthenticated control API on 127.0.0.1:3080 by the Host header alone, so a confined agent could call it and grant itself danger-full-access. The log recorded it as a user action. CVE-2026-82533, CVSS 9.4, fixed in 0.1.2-alpha.1. https://www. ox.security/blog/cve-2026-8253 3-deepseek-harness-ai-agent-sandbox-escape/ # Cybersecurity # AIAgents # AppSec
